text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Zine al-Abidine Ben Ali on Tuesday held a meeting with Interior Minister Mohamed Ben Rejeb.
- President Ben Ali on Monday visited "Hannibal" gas plant in the southern region of Sfax.
- Tunisia on Tuesday granted Australian group Broken Hill Prop. Co (BHP) a mining exploration permit in Jebel Trozza in the central province of Kairouan.
- No Tunisian pilgrims were among the victims in Tuesday's fire near Mecca in Saudi Arabia.
- President Ben Ali on Tuesday named Abdeljelil Zaddem governor in the southern region of Kebili.
